ideas.modern_name: Grothendieck's monodromy pairing on component groups (ℓ-part, including p-part)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck, SGA 7 I Exp. IX (1967-69, publ. 1972)

ideas.what: Identification of the homomorphism (9.5.6) from a double extension with the inertia action defined in 9.2 (left to the reader)

ideas.where_published: SGA 7 I, Exp. IX, end of 9.5

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a printed page of SGA 7 I, Exp. IX (published 1972), stray among the 1975-76 de Rham notes. Its content is well known and credited to Grothendieck. The later fate of his perfectness conjecture is in the literature: counterexamples for imperfect residue fields (Bertapelle–Bosch) and a proof for perfect residue fields (Suzuki). Nothing here is new.
transcription_corrections: Page header '- 118 - IX' and stamp '436': this is SGA 7 I Exp. IX typescript (LNM 288 pagination), not part of the handwritten divided-power de Rham notes on the neighbouring pages.
In (9.6.1) the image shows P = T_ℓ(A^o)^t = M̌'_ℓ(1) (with prime) and later P' = M̌_ℓ(1) (no prime); the transcription is consistent with the image.
